title: Create a personal homepage
goal: Turn your personal introduction and work list into a homepage with a clear structure and jumpable features.
summary: Use header to store names and opening introductions, use main to mark the main body, and use section to distinguish different topics. In-page links are positioned to the work area via fragment identifiers, and CSS makes the introduction area more legible.
tasks: Change .profile-intro to header and .profile-content to main in index.html. Keep the top name "Linxi".
Put "About me" and "works" into the section under main respectively, using the two IDs about and work. Keep a list of two work titles.
lets "View works" jump to the work area. Add #e2f1eb background and 20px padding around .profile-intro in style.css.
hint: The start tag and end tag need to be replaced together. Use # to add the target id to the href of the link. After clicking, check whether the address fragment points to the work area.

example.code:
Photography Club Recruitment

Check event time

activity time

Meet at the activity center at 10 a.m. on Saturday.
example.note: The new recruitment page divides the introduction and content into two areas. Clicking the link will locate the activity area with the ID schedule.
